fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.mimic_be: Mimic Beetles are colonial organisms that inhabit certain ores. These small bugs work together to form a larger, more imposing organism to defend their home. Offering them a Terrantula Leg or Gill may convince them to abandon their home and scatter.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.allman.d: Allmen are ancient prisoners of an unknown civilization. When attacked, they have a chance to summon help through their Shackled flying creations.
Banshaas are smaller, louder Ghasts from the Overworld and the Nether. They dislike direct combat, but won't hesitate to scream and lure other monsters toward their prey.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.grimmsqu: Disgusting warm biome farers. Grimmsquitoes spawn in jungles, swamps, and deserts, but it's recommended to avoid looking at their horrible little arthopod faces. They will fly around and inflict various harmful effects upon landing an attack.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.mimentis: Mimentises are masters of disguise. Lacking any offensive abilities, they instead copy the likeness and movesets of other monsters, running away whenever their disguise is broken.

fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.patuti.d: Patutis are fish-like monsters often hunted for their gills. Their short stature is deceptive; they're fast, agile hunters who like to hide in humid places.
Easily mistaken to be a Golem, Pioneers are purely mechanical in nature. Whoever built them remains a mystery. They have a natural dislike for Scowls and Terrantulas, using their tough copper exteriors to make quick work of them.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.reanimat: Its flesh has been reawakened by the lightning coursing through its plating. This miniboss can be summoned by striking a special structure with a Channeling trident. It strikes nearby entities with lightning, so it's best to keep your distance.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.scowl.de: Scowls are said to be the monstrous winged relatives of the Glare. They use their rotting insides to spit out poisonous gas clouds, and while they can fly, their wings are only used for limited steering. They rely instead on an air-filled sac that keeps them buoyant. This sac can be popped with an arrow.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.seer.des: Seers form when undead souls with no body converge in a single spot. They're made of a non-Newtonian jelly that hardens on impact, greatly amplifying the knockback of their attacks.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.shackled: These creations aren't much of a threat on their own, but when they break, they leave behind a blinding cloud.
fieldguide.entity.fightsfrights.terrantu: Terrantulas are the shier cousins of the Spider. They wait below ground for their prey to get close, then pounce once the time is right. If a Terrantula is hit multiple times, it may temporarily dig underground to reposition for a better attack.
